answer.reason: The EIA Maryland Electricity Profile 2024 lists IPP & CHP net generation as 2,973,907 MWh, while 32,450,909 MWh corresponds to the much larger utility category.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Maryland Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 2,973,907 megawatthours
B. 32,450,909 megawatthours

Source citation: Maryland Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/maryland/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: A
